project: Ziemia — ciągła akcja w ujęciach z lotu ptaka

execution_constraints.quota_policy: Confirm remaining allowance before each root-controlled generation. Do not bypass quota, login, queue priority, or rate limits. Chat tokens are unrelated to GPU quota. Seven clips may not fit one day's allowance; no free-completion claim is made.
execution_constraints.secrets: Never put an HF token, authorization header, or credential binding in this manifest or prompt files.
execution_constraints.gpu_reservation_note: Deployed Space auto-selects xlarge; 75-second GPU duration reserves 150 free quota seconds.

continuity: Every shot remains a single uninterrupted high aerial wide view. Preserve river bends, town and mountains. The bridge retry completes the existing anchored unfinished bridge; other construction uses the localized target described in each prompt. No close-ups or internal cuts.

shots.primary_action: Herd walking with individual leg cycles and water interaction
Fire front propagating from already burning into intact woodland
Individual trees falling and logs being removed, leaving stumps
Hut frames, rafters and thatched roofs assembled on bare plots
shots.generation_note: Root owns this prompt and its wide-view reroll. Do not use the earlier take that cuts to a human close-up.

shots.primary_action: Masonry and deck sections close visible gaps along an already anchored unfinished central bridge
shots.generation_note: Generate a unique take bridge_take2. Original clips/bridge is rejected. Only select the replacement after positive hash-bound semantic review.

shots.primary_action: A new factory wing grows through rigid framing, brickwork and roof-truss stages
One low foreground building gains rigid floors and facade rows while adjacent skyline remains fixed

acceptance: Reject any take that cuts to a person, animal close-up, machinery close-up or a different camera position.
Reject camera-only motion, whole-frame zoom, architecture morphs, opacity reveals, forest fading, or global dissolves used instead of action.
Accept only footage showing local physical changes or independent actor motion against an unchanged wide valley.
Requested clip durations may produce 8k+1 frame counts. The assembler must trim/count frames to exactly 1440 final frames rather than assuming the provider's MP4 duration equals the requested number.
Root alone selects accepted output paths; this manifest does not assert that any of these seven final shots has already been generated or passed review.
path_base: film_pipeline directory; paths below are relative to it
